fields.why: The claims rest on proportions (lesion sites, hospitalization by vaccination status). The median vaccination-to-diagnosis interval and median sex partners describe the cases' characteristics, not the illness's own course, so they do not make the outcome continuous.

The report names a cluster investigation, so outbreak investigation is preferred; adding case report/series for a 40-case cluster description is defensible but not named (A's evidence is only the table title).

The race ranking is the composition of one 40-case series (shares of cases), not a group-specific outcome compared across 3+ race groups; the Table compares vaccination groups, with race as a row characteristic and no test. The brief should say case-composition shares by an SPD within a single series are descriptors, not groupwise entries.

brief_issues: Groupwise: state whether ranked case-composition shares by an SPD (one case series, no per-group outcome) count as 'side by side'.
